assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
The patient has an unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
There is concern for potential embolic events or hemodynamic instability
CPT 93229 Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring is medically necessary
The service is directly indicated for this episode and is not excluded by the payer's coverage parameters
